findings: loadPersistedResults and stale-background restore reuse validatedCache without revalidating filesystem after initial load. ResetToIdle does not clear this cache in the reviewed range; subsequent invalidation methods remain unread.
Fresh Complete state clears selectedForDeletion and spaceToReclaim, a useful guard against carrying selections across scans. Persisted load/fallback does not clear selections in this range.

Complete-state collector clears scoped results for FULL while service separately persists results after publishing Complete. These independent coroutine operations can interleave with cache loading; exact race behavior untested.

CoilPreloader is called for flattened items in every result group, including overlapping membership. It does not deduplicate here, so repeated enqueue requests are possible; loader-level coalescing unqualified.
Unreadable summary count uses isPathExcludedFromScan while displayed list uses isUiHidden, which additionally hides hyphen-prefixed filenames. The count can exceed visible entries.

Cancelled/error state triggers persisted-result loading via a separately launched viewModelScope job, so collectLatest does not directly own/cancel that child load. Late-load publication ordering still requires remaining code/runtime review.
